resources.string: A second phone on the same Wi-Fi joins as player 2 by scanning a QR code. Both need the same game in their library.
Match in progress. Pausing here pauses the other player too.
On the other phone: open Retrovika, tap the QR button at the top of Home and point at this code. Same Wi-Fi (or one on the other\'s hotspot), same game in the library.
Sending the game to the other phone. Both start from exactly the same moment.
The other player left. The game goes on here.
Connection lost. The game goes on here.
Couldn\'t reach the other phone. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi and that the QR code is still on screen there.
You don\'t have this game in your library. It needs: %1$s (%2$s)
No local network found. Connect to Wi-Fi or turn on the hotspot.
Not available during a network match.
